modules.title: 1. Tree Decompositions, HLD & Subtree Aggregates
modules.description: Tree problems in the 1900–2300 range test Euler Tour subtree flattening, Small-to-Large merging (sack), Heavy-Light Decomposition (HLD), and Centroid Decomposition / Tree Divide & Conquer.

problems.name: Tree Queries
problems.insight: Flatten trees into enter/exit timestamp intervals to reduce ancestor-descendant queries to subsegment containment.

problems.name: Reset K Edges
problems.insight: Binary search on the tree height; greedily cut edges from deepest subtrees whose depth from their current component root reaches the target limit.

problems.name: Li Hua and Tree
problems.insight: Maintain subtree sizes and heavy child pointers dynamically; rotate the heavy son to the parent in $O(\log N)$ using `std::set`.

problems.name: Tree XOR
problems.insight: Bit-by-bit contribution: when transitioning root $u \to v$, exactly subtree sizes of $u$ and $v$ flip their contribution multiplier to the total cost.

problems.name: Unusual Entertainment
problems.insight: Map subtree containment to range queries on permutation indices; answer queries offline using a Fenwick tree or merge-sort tree.

problems.name: A Growing Tree
problems.insight: Process dynamic vertex additions offline: map tree additions to subtree range increments at vertex creation timestamps.

problems.name: Count Paths
problems.insight: Count simple paths whose endpoints share a color by maintaining dominant color frequencies and merging small-to-large in $O(N \log N)$.

problems.name: Counting Graphs
problems.insight: Process MST edges in increasing weight order; merging components of size $sz_1$ and $sz_2$ allows $(sz_1 \cdot sz_2 - 1)$ optional edges with weights in $[w_i + 1, S]$.

problems.name: Xor Tree
problems.insight: In a binary trie, any node with both children can keep at most 1 element from one branch to prevent cycles in the XOR minimum spanning tree.

problems.name: Preorder
problems.insight: Recursively compute the canonical lexicographically minimal preorder traversal for each subtree; branching factor is 2 only if child subtrees are non-isomorphic.

problems.name: Timofey and Black-White Tree
problems.insight: Maintain minimum distance to black nodes by updating centroid ancestor paths, or prune traversals at the current global minimum in $O(N \sqrt{N})$.

problems.name: Chain Queries
problems.insight: Maintain whether a subset of nodes forms a simple path by dynamically tracking black nodes whose parent is white.

problems.name: Penchick and Chloe's Trees
problems.insight: Minimize tree depth by greedy bottom-up pooling of child subproblem depths using a min-heap.

problems.name: Equidistant Vertices
problems.insight: Root the tree at every candidate center; for a fixed distance d, count combinations choosing 1 node from k distinct branches using knapsack DP.

problems.name: X(or)-mas Tree
problems.insight: Translate path XOR parity conditions into potential differences between nodes, detecting contradictions via DSU with parity tracking.

problems.name: Tree Master
problems.insight: Answer heavy depth-indexed ancestor product queries by memoizing pairs of high-degree nodes at the same tree depth.

problems.name: Compressed Tree
problems.insight: Analyze node degree cases: degree $0$, $1$ (path endpoint), $2$ (identity pass-through), or $\ge 3$ (all positive child subtrees retained).

problems.name: Sakurako and Chefir
problems.insight: Answer maximum tree-path jumps by combining Euler tour segment trees with binary lifting to query branch maximums.

problems.name: Tree Array
problems.insight: By linearity of expectation, sum the probability that $u$ appears before $v$ for each pair $(u, v)$ using grid walk DP based on depths to $\text{LCA}(u, v)$.

problems.name: Unique Occurrences
problems.insight: For each edge color, isolate active components using tree divide & conquer with DSU rollbacks to count paths containing exactly one edge of each color in $O(N \log^2 N)$.

problems.name: There Should Be a Lot of Maximums
problems.insight: Track tree-wide frequencies across edge removals using Euler tour prefix and suffix frequency multiset aggregations.

problems.name: Happy Life in University
problems.insight: Maintain distinct color counts on root-to-node paths via lazy range updates on Euler subsegments.

modules.title: 2. Data Structures, Cartesian Trees & Offline Reductions
modules.description: Div. 1 A/B data structure problems prioritize offline sorting, monotonic invariants, Cartesian tree reductions, and square-root thresholding.

problems.name: Permutation Addicts
problems.insight: Map prefix/suffix extrema to directed edges forming a tree; reconstruct the permutation by topological DFS ordering based on branch sizes.

problems.name: Microcycle
problems.insight: Sort edges in descending weight; the first edge that connects two already-connected components identifies the cycle with maximum minimal edge.

problems.name: Count the Trains
problems.insight: Maintain non-increasing prefix minima dynamically by deleting dominated intervals in amortized $O(\log N)$.

problems.name: Range Sorting (Easy Version)
problems.insight: The range sorting cost equals (r - l) minus the count of irreducible break points; count contribution of each index using monotonic stacks.

problems.name: Vlad and the Mountains
problems.insight: Sort elevation constraints and queries offline; add allowed edges progressively to answer path reachability via DSU.

problems.name: Wonderful Tree!
problems.insight: Satisfy node sum invariants by greedily pushing excess capacity up from deepest available descendants with minimum distance penalty.

problems.name: Skyline Photo
problems.insight: Maintain active building segments using a monotonic stack while propagating optimal DP transitions into a Segment Tree.

problems.name: Boring Segments
problems.technique: Two Pointers + Lazy Range Addition SegTree
problems.insight: Sort segments by weight; use two pointers to maintain a valid covering of [1, M] using a lazy Segment Tree storing range minimums.

problems.name: Array Collapse
problems.insight: Optimize $O(N^2)$ deletion DP into $O(N)$ by bounding subproblems using Cartesian tree / nearest smaller element boundaries.

problems.name: 01 Tree
problems.insight: A valid leaf configuration allows repeatedly eliminating local maxima that are adjacent to elements of value $(\max - 1)$; simulate in $O(N \log N)$.

problems.name: Clear the Multiset
problems.insight: Compare doing 1 horizontal subtraction of size $\min(A)$ across the whole range vs solving left and right subproblems independently in $O(N)$.

problems.name: Equilibrium
problems.technique: Prefix Sums + Sparse Table Range Extrema
problems.insight: Express balance as difference array $D_i = b_i - a_i$; verify prefix sum conditions ($P_r = P_{l-1}$ and $P_k \ge P_{l-1}$) via Range Max/Min queries.

problems.name: Ezzat and Grid
problems.insight: Find the longest chain of intersecting segments across rows via coordinate compression and range maximum query SegTree with backpointers.

problems.name: Train Maintenance
problems.insight: Split periodic schedules at $\sqrt{M}$: update difference arrays for large periods, and maintain $\bmod k$ frequency tables for small periods.

problems.name: Trader Problem
problems.insight: Sort value differences and queries offline; merge adjacent items into contiguous blocks that trade freely and maintain top-k prefix sums.

problems.name: Fill the Matrix
problems.insight: Decompose the unfilled matrix space into rectangular blocks using Cartesian tree divide & conquer; greedily place contiguous sequences in largest blocks.

problems.name: Ksyusha and the Loaded Set
problems.insight: Maintain gaps between consecutive present elements in a Segment Tree to query the first available contiguous interval of length $k$ in $O(\log V)$.

problems.name: Number of Groups
problems.technique: Sweep Line + Two Priority Queues DSU
problems.insight: Instead of $O(N^2)$ segment intersections, sweep coordinates and unify overlapping segments across different colors via priority queues in $O(N \log N)$.

problems.name: Li Hua and Array
problems.insight: Take advantage of the fact that $\phi(x)$ reaches $1$ in $O(\log V)$ steps to prune Segment Tree range updates to $O(N \log^2 V)$ amortized.

modules.title: 3. Randomization, Polynomial Hashing & Treaps / Cartesian Trees
modules.description: Randomization and Cartesian trees turn complex structural matching, range frequency checks, and non-deterministic state spaces into simple O(1) or O(log N) algorithms.

problems.name: Strange Definition
problems.insight: Two numbers multiply to a square iff their square-free prime factor masks are identical; after 1 step, all even-frequency masks collapse to 1.

problems.name: Dasha and Nightmares
problems.insight: Iterate over which character is omitted (26 choices); pair bitmasks whose XOR sum equals the full 25-bit mask with zero collisions.

problems.name: Shuffling Songs
problems.insight: Hash genres and writers to integers; run Hamiltonian path bitmask DP in $O(2^N \cdot N)$ to find the maximum song subset matching consecutive traits.

problems.name: Robin Hood Archery
problems.insight: Assign a random 64-bit integer to each value; a subarray [L, R] can be paired up into identical pairs if and only if its range XOR sum equals 0.

problems.name: Amazing Trick
problems.insight: Randomly shuffle permutations and match cycles; prove that the expected number of iterations until a valid derangement is found is bounded by $O(1)$.

problems.name: The Strongest Build
problems.insight: Start from the maximal tuple; perform BFS over coordinate decrements using a priority queue and 64-bit tuple hash to skip banned combinations in $O(M \log M)$.

problems.name: Masha-forgetful
problems.insight: Any valid partition into segments of length $\ge 2$ decomposes into blocks of length $2$ and $3$; hash all substrings of length $2/3$ for $O(N)$ string DP.

problems.name: Wish I Knew How to Sort
problems.insight: State is the number of $0$s currently in the correct prefix of length $\text{count}(0)$; compute transition probability $p_k$ and solve 1D expected value DP.

problems.name: Non-Palindromic Substring
problems.insight: A substring has no good $k$-length partition iff it has period $1$ (all same char) or period $2$ (alternating chars); verify via rolling polynomial hashes in $O(1)$.

problems.name: GCD of an Array
problems.insight: For each prime $p$, maintain a multiset of prime exponents across all array elements; track the min exponent dynamically to maintain global GCD in $O(Q \log N \log V)$.

problems.name: Assimilation IV
problems.insight: Calculate expected coverage as sum over all cities of P(city is covered); compute complement P(city is never reached) by sorting required monument arrival times.

problems.name: Symmetree
problems.insight: Compute randomized subtree hash signatures to detect tree symmetry/isomorphism bottom-up in $O(N)$.

problems.name: Sofia and Strings
problems.insight: Sorting a substring allows pulling smaller characters forward but never jumping over strictly smaller characters; maintain 26 character index queues in $O(N)$.

problems.name: Penacony
problems.technique: XOR Hashing / Dual Cut on Cycle
problems.insight: Assign random 64-bit masks to paths; use difference arrays on the cyclic graph to find the edge covered by the maximum path mask subset.

problems.name: Intersection and Union
problems.insight: Model bitwise transitions as 2x2 transition matrices over {0, 1} states; maintain matrix products with a Segment Tree over coordinate events.

problems.name: Yet Another Array Counting Problem
problems.insight: Range maximum queries uniquely define a Cartesian Tree; formulate an $O(N \cdot M)$ tree DP on the Cartesian Tree structure.

modules.title: 4. Dynamic Programming Optimizations
modules.description: Focus on reducing transitions from O(N^2) to O(N log N) or O(N) using monotonicity, prefix sums, Fenwick / Segment trees, and state pruning.

problems.name: TediousLee
problems.insight: Level n Rauxa tree contains 1 root, 1 level (n-1) tree, and 2 level (n-2) trees; transition DP greedily claiming claw roots whenever child claws are free.

problems.name: Escape The Maze (hard version)
problems.insight: Precompute nearest friend distance using multi-source BFS; DFS from root to find minimal set of subtrees where friend arrives strictly before Vlad.

problems.name: Paths on the Tree
problems.insight: For any node with $k$ paths, every child receives either $\lfloor k/c \rfloor$ or $\lceil k/c \rceil$ paths; branch into at most 2 states per subtree.

problems.name: Two Chess Pieces
problems.insight: A piece must visit all required nodes plus any d-th ancestors of the other piece; isolate marked subtree sizes to evaluate minimum total edge traversals.

problems.name: Sasha and a Walk in the City
problems.insight: Bound the count of dangerous vertices on any downward path to at most 2, aggregating valid independent subsets bottom-up.

problems.name: Moving Chips
problems.insight: Compress column states into 2 choices: ending chip on row 0 or row 1; transition across non-empty column boundaries adding minimum shift costs.

problems.name: The Omnipotent Monster Killer
problems.insight: Prove that any tree can be cleared in at most $\lceil\log_2 N\rceil + 1$ rounds; run tree DP over $O(\log N)$ attack turns.

problems.name: Optimal Partition
problems.insight: Partition subsegments based on prefix sum signs (positive, zero, negative); query 3 separate Fenwick trees for optimal transitions in $O(N \log N)$.

problems.name: Discrete Centrifugal Jumps
problems.insight: A valid jump cannot cross intermediate elements exceeding both endpoints; restrict transitions to strictly nearest larger/smaller elements in $O(N)$.

problems.name: LaIS
problems.insight: Extend LIS DP to allow one non-decreasing dip by querying past DP maxima up to the nearest greater element to the left via Fenwick tree.

problems.name: Phoenix and Computers
problems.insight: Construct the sequence by placing contiguous blocks of computers manually turned on, counting interleavings using binomial coefficients.

problems.name: Telepanting
problems.insight: The time to travel from portal $i$ to $x_i$ after activation equals $x_i - y_i$ plus total delay of all intermediate portals; evaluate via prefix sums in $O(N)$.

problems.name: Sum Over Zero
problems.insight: Rewrite condition $\sum_{k=l}^r a_k \ge 0$ as $P_r \ge P_{l-1}$; query the maximum past $\text{DP}[l-1] - (l-1)$ using a coordinate-compressed Fenwick tree.

problems.name: Trees and Segments
problems.insight: Precompute max consecutive $0$s achievable in prefix and suffix using two pointers; combine with a fixed run of $1$s of length $len_1$ to optimize over all weights.

problems.name: MEXimize the Score
problems.insight: Evaluate total sum of MEX as $\sum_k P(\text{MEX} \ge k)$; compute distribution of minimum frequencies across values $0$ to $k-1$ via dynamic programming.

problems.name: Unique Median
problems.insight: Fix the unique median value M; replace >M with +1, <M with -1, and use prefix balance frequency arrays to count subarrays where M is strictly dominant.

problems.name: Another MEX Problem
problems.insight: Only minimal subsegments defining each distinct MEX can be part of the optimal partition; prune transitions to at most $O(N)$ active segments in $O(N^2 / 64)$.

modules.title: 5. Graph Structure, 2-SAT & Connectivity
modules.description: Graph problems in this range focus on Tarjan bridge/cut-vertex trees, DFS back-edge properties, 2-SAT implication graphs, and SCC reachability DAGs.

problems.name: Tree Tag
problems.insight: Alice wins iff $\text{dist}(a, b) \le da$, or $2da \ge db$, or $2da \ge \text{tree\_diameter}$; otherwise Bob can always escape to an antipodal branch.

problems.name: 2+ doors
problems.insight: Decompose into independent bit planes; enforce forced bits first, then greedily assign 0s where no future constraint is violated.

problems.name: Rudolf and CodeVid-23
problems.insight: Model patient symptoms as a bitmask of size $\le 10$; build a directed state graph with $2^N$ vertices and find shortest path from initial mask to $0$ in $O(M \cdot 2^N)$.

problems.name: Non-academic Problem
problems.insight: Identify bridges using Tarjan DFS; removing edge (u, v) splits the graph into components of size s and N-s, minimizing pair reachability.

problems.name: Edge Split
problems.insight: A spanning tree has M - N + 1 back-edges; when they form a 3-cycle, swap one back-edge with a tree edge to eliminate cycles in the non-tree subgraph.

problems.name: Sum Graph
problems.insight: Add edges to create a simple path graph; query longest distance from an arbitrary node to find the endpoints, reconstructing node values in $\le 2N$ queries.

problems.name: Ehab's Last Corollary
problems.technique: DFS Tree Cycles vs Independent Set
problems.insight: In any connected graph, find either an induced cycle of length $\le k$ or an independent set of size $\lceil k/2 \rceil$ using DFS tree back-edges.

problems.name: How Many Paths?
problems.insight: Classify paths from vertex 1 into {0, 1, 2, inf} by detecting cycle reachability with SCCs / DFS back-edges and propagating along the DAG.

problems.name: Robots on a Grid
problems.insight: Each cell has out-degree 1 forming a functional graph; count cycle lengths L and group cells by their distance modulo L to check black cell availability.

problems.name: Strange Housing
problems.insight: A connected graph always admits a valid configuration by greedily picking nodes in BFS order and skipping immediate neighbors of selected nodes.

problems.name: Travelling Salesman Problem
problems.insight: Base cost is $\sum c_i$; sort cities by $a_i$ and greedily bridge gaps between $\max(a_j + c_j)$ and the next city $a_{i+1}$ in $O(N \log N)$.

problems.name: Moment of Bloom
problems.insight: Path endpoints require odd-degree vertices; on a spanning tree, pair up odd-parity branches greedily to reconstruct paths or detect odd-degree vertices.

problems.name: AND-MEX Walk
problems.insight: Answer is 0 if u and v are connected by an edge subset sharing any single bit; answer is 1 if u can reach any even-weight incident edge in bit b.

problems.name: Count Seconds
problems.insight: Simulate the first N seconds directly to eliminate zero-value underflow boundaries, then propagate all remaining values algebraically in topological order modulo 998244353.

problems.name: Edge Reverse
problems.insight: Binary search on the maximum edge weight to reverse; verify if reversing edges of weight $\le W$ makes the graph have a unique source in the SCC DAG.

modules.title: 6. Network Flow, Min-Cost Flow & Bipartite Matchings
modules.description: At the 1900–2300 level, flow problems appear as bipartite matching via König theorem, Hall Marriage Theorem bounds, Min-Cut partitions, or Min-Cost Flow slope trick reductions.

problems.name: Valuable Paper
problems.insight: Binary search on the maximum allowable edge weight; build a bipartite graph on factory-warehouse pairs and test for a perfect matching of size N.

problems.name: Programming Competition
problems.insight: Pair up employees from different subtrees bottom-up; if one child subtree size exceeds half the total, recursively pair inside the heavy child.

problems.name: Vlad and Trouble at MIT
problems.insight: Partition tree vertices into Party vs Sleep sets separated by minimum closed walls; model as Min-Cut on a flow network (or solve via tree DP).

problems.name: Canteen (Easy Version)
problems.technique: Greedy Min-Cost Flow on a Line
problems.insight: Model food demands and supplies along a linear chain; greedily satisfy nearest requests while maintaining capacity bounds in $O(N)$.

problems.name: Engineer Artem
problems.insight: Color the grid in chessboard pattern; ensure all (i+j) even cells have even values and (i+j) odd cells have odd values by adding at most 1 to any cell.

problems.name: Koxia and Game
problems.insight: Model $(a_i, b_i)$ as edges; a valid choice of elements exists if each connected component is a pseudo-tree (contains exactly one cycle).

problems.name: Serval and Kaitenzushi Buffet
problems.insight: Model conveyor belt pickup intervals as an assignment problem; greedily assign items using priority queues to maximize total matched throughput.

problems.name: New Year's Puzzle
problems.insight: A 2xN grid with blocked cells has a valid domino tiling iff the chessboard parity differences between consecutive single-blocked cells match.

problems.name: Grouped Carriages
problems.insight: Binary search on the maximum carriage capacity Z; greedily satisfy range flow constraints using a Segment Tree / priority queue.

problems.name: Swap to Rearrange
problems.insight: Transform string balance swap requirements into a 2-regular directed graph; find an Eulerian circuit to decompose swaps into valid cycles in $O(N)$.

problems.name: Paired Payment
problems.insight: Cost of paired edges $(w_1 + w_2)^2$ expands as $w_1^2 + 2w_1 w_2 + w_2^2$; construct a layered state graph with states $(u, last\_w)$ and run Dijkstra.

problems.name: Kirill and Company
problems.insight: Construct the shortest-path DAG from vertex $1$; compress friend subsets into bitmasks ($\le 6$ people without cars) and find maximal path coverage.

problems.name: The Most Reckless Defense
problems.insight: Model tower range coverage costs as a minimum-cost bipartite assignment problem, optimizing transitions over circular radii via bitmask DP.

problems.name: Canteen (Hard Version)
problems.insight: Express the minimum food transport cost as a min-cost flow problem on a line; simulate successive shortest augmenting paths using a Segment Tree in $O(N \log N)$.

problems.name: Twin Polynomials
problems.insight: Express matching counts between root sets as polynomial coefficients; apply inclusion-exclusion over shared factors in $O(N \log N)$.

modules.title: 7. Computational Geometry (1900–2300)
modules.description: Competitive geometry up to 2300 focuses on metric transformations, convex hulls & rotating calipers, angular sweep line, and lattice point geometry (Pick Theorem).

problems.name: Lena and Matrix
problems.insight: Rotate coordinates $(x, y) \to (x+y, x-y)$; the maximum Manhattan distance to any point is determined solely by the 4 extreme boundary values.

problems.name: The Butcher
problems.insight: The original rectangle dimensions (W, H) must match either the max width or max height among remaining pieces; greedily peel off cuts.

problems.name: Not So Simple Polygon Embedding
problems.insight: Find the optimal rotation angle that minimizes the bounding box of a regular 2n-gon using trigonometric projections and symmetry.

problems.name: Circular Mirror
problems.insight: Points whose angular distance is exactly pi form diameter pairs; decompose the circle into D diameter chords and independent points.

problems.name: Game With Triangles
problems.insight: Points lie on y=0 and y=2; triangle area is determined by base length. Formulate max score as a concave function and ternary search.

problems.name: Birthday
problems.insight: Decompose the cake boundary into monotone angular wedges; evaluate valid cutting lines using cross product orientation tests.

problems.name: Rain
problems.insight: The water height is a piecewise linear function. Removing cloud j must decrease all violated peak heights, mapping to 4 linear halfplane checks.

problems.name: Game With Triangles: Season 2
problems.insight: Optimize triangle selections across multiple lines via convex DP hull transitions and slope monotonicity in $O(N \log N)$.

problems.name: Nezzar and Nice Beatmap
problems.insight: To guarantee every consecutive angle $< 90^\circ$, greedily jump to the strictly farthest remaining point in $O(N^2)$.

problems.name: Interactive Treasure Hunt
problems.insight: Use sum and difference queries $(r_1+r_2, c_1+c_2)$ from boundary corners to uniquely locate two hidden points in $\le 7$ interactive scan operations.

problems.name: Chemistry Lab
problems.insight: Model concentration ratios as continuous line segments; find optimal contract allocations by maintaining the upper convex envelope.

problems.name: Vittorio Plays with LEGO Bricks
problems.insight: Triangles with slope $\pm 1$ intersect at height $h = (x_r - x_l)/2$; formulate an $O(N^3)$ interval DP merging adjacent overlapping triangles.

problems.name: Covering Points with Circles
problems.insight: Construct minimal circle covers by analyzing the convex hull of point clusters and finding common tangent alignments.

problems.name: Gregor and the Odd Cows (Easy)
problems.insight: Apply $\text{Area} = I + B/2 - 1 \pmod 2$. Since coordinates are multiples of $2$, classify all points into $(x \bmod 4, y \bmod 4)$ in $O(1)$.

problems.name: Building an Amusement Park
problems.insight: Binary search on radius $R$; each point $P_i$ inside distance $2R$ covers a valid polar angle interval on circle $C(0, R)$. Find max interval overlap.

problems.name: City Union
problems.technique: Manhattan Convex Hull / Bounding Box Unions
problems.insight: A city is connected and convex iff its row and column intervals are contiguous; iteratively expand the bounding boxes of the 2 components until union is convex.

problems.name: Tenzing and Triangle
problems.insight: Right-isosceles triangles under line x+y=k have cost proportional to side length; sweep coordinate x and maintain DP transitions via range additions.

modules.title: 8. Linear Basis, Bitwise Invariants & Number Theory
modules.description: CF heavily favors linear algebra over GF(2), invariant reductions, contribution counting per bit, and bit-trie operations.

problems.name: GameGame
problems.insight: Find the highest bit where the total count of 1s is odd. If count % 4 == 1, Koa (first) wins; if count % 4 == 3, parity of remaining 0s decides winner.

problems.name: Genius's Gambit
problems.insight: To get x - y with exactly k ones, shift a single 1 by k positions across zeros (1...0... - 0...1... = 0111...1); handle edge cases k=0 and lack of 0s.

problems.name: Yet Another Problem
problems.technique: Prefix XOR Parity + Range Query SegTree
problems.insight: A range of odd length can be zeroed in 1 step iff range XOR sum is 0; even length can be zeroed in 2 steps iff there is an internal odd prefix with XOR sum 0.

problems.name: A BIT of an Inequality
problems.insight: Find the MSB for each element; count valid subarrays by tracking prefix and suffix XOR parities at that specific bit position.

problems.name: XOR Construction
problems.insight: Prefix XORs determine all values relative to $a_0$; insert all prefix XORs into a bit-trie to verify if an $a_0$ exists such that all values are $< n$.

problems.name: XOR-gun
problems.insight: By the Pigeonhole Principle, among $> 60$ numbers, three must share the same MSB and can be merged in 1 step; for $N \le 60$, brute force in $O(N^3)$.

problems.name: XOR Inverse
problems.insight: Determine the optimal inversion bit by bit from MSB to LSB independently using a binary Trie to count inversions created vs resolved.

problems.name: Reverse
problems.insight: Appending 0/1 and reversing only allows trimming trailing zeros and appending 1s; test whether binary representation of x is a substring of y or rev(y).

problems.name: GCD Guess
problems.insight: Recover $x \pmod{2^{30}}$ bit by bit: query $\gcd(x + (2^i - cur), x + (2^i - cur) + 2^{i+1})$; if divisible by $2^{i+1}$, the $i$-th bit is determined.

problems.name: Kevin and And
problems.insight: Precompute max reduction for each element using k operations via subset DP over m masks; the marginal gains are concave, so greedily take top-k reductions.

problems.name: Present
problems.insight: For bit $k$, take elements modulo $2^{k+1}$; the $k$-th sum bit is $1$ iff $(a_i + a_j) \bmod 2^{k+1}$ falls in $[2^k, 2^{k+1}-1]$ or $[3 \cdot 2^k, 2^{k+2}-2]$. Count via two pointers.

problems.name: Euclid's nightmare
problems.insight: Treat vectors over GF(2) as edges in a graph with a virtual source 0; greedily maintain linear independence by adding non-cyclic edges via DSU.

problems.name: Treelabeling
problems.insight: Partition tree vertices into bipartite sets; decompose the smaller component into powers of 2 matching MSB ranges so no u XOR v can equal min(u, v).

problems.name: ConstructOR
problems.insight: Construct $x$ satisfying $(a \mid x)$ is a multiple of $2^k$ and divisible by $d$ using bit-by-bit fixing with modular inverse modulo $2^k$.

problems.name: The Human Equation
problems.insight: Alternating $\pm 1$ operations change adjacent prefix sums by $\pm 1$; the minimum operations required equals $\max(P) - \min(P)$.

problems.name: The Harmonization of XOR
problems.insight: Pair each number $i$ with $i \oplus x$ if $\le n$; greedily form independent sets with XOR sum $x$ and merge all remaining elements into the last set.

problems.name: Candy Party (Hard Version)
problems.insight: Each person can give $2^x$ and receive $2^y$; decompose difference $(a_i - \text{avg})$ into minimal power of two additions/subtractions and balance total net flows.

problems.name: Perfect Triples
problems.insight: The triplet components follow a recursive base-4 digit permutation mapping: $(0 \to 0, 1 \to 2, 2 \to 3, 3 \to 1)$ for the second element $b$.

problems.name: Three Sequences
problems.insight: Express $a_i = b_i + c_i$ where $b$ is non-decreasing and $c$ is non-increasing; the optimal $\max(b_n, c_1)$ equals $\lceil(a_1 + \sum \max(0, \text{diff}_i)) / 2\rceil$.

problems.name: Powerful Ksenia
problems.insight: Triplets $(a_i, a_j, a_k) \to \text{XOR sum}$ allow equalizing all odd $N$ elements in $(N-1)$ operations; even $N$ requires total XOR sum $= 0$.

problems.name: Hemose on the Tree
problems.insight: Assign $2^p$ to the root; alternatingly assign $(2^p + i)$ to node and $i$ to incident edge (or vice versa) on odd/even depths to keep all path XORs within bounds.

problems.name: Serval and Shift-Shift-Shift
problems.insight: Use the highest set bit as an elimination pivot to eliminate differing bits from left to right (or right to left) in $\le n$ operations.

problems.name: Vasya and Array
problems.insight: Compute $a_i \bmod a_j = a_i - k \cdot a_j$ by querying multiples $k \cdot a_j$ in a Fenwick tree in $O(V \log V)$ total harmonic updates.

schedule.title: Trees, HLD & Centroid Decomposition
schedule.summary: Master enter/exit timestamp flattening, dynamic heavy child rotations, small-to-large merging (sack), HLD path queries, and tree divide & conquer.

schedule.title: Data Structures & Cartesian Trees
schedule.summary: Build Cartesian trees from monotonic stacks, maintain sweep-line priority queues, and prune state updates with square root thresholding.

schedule.title: Randomization & Polynomial Hashing
schedule.summary: Apply 64-bit randomized XOR hashing, Merkle tree signatures, Las Vegas randomized derangements, and Cartesian tree DP.

schedule.title: DP Optimizations & State Transitions
schedule.summary: Delegate transitions to Fenwick / Segment trees, exploit monotonic stack boundaries, quotient splitting, and component merge DP.

schedule.title: Graphs, 2-SAT & Network Flows
schedule.summary: Master Tarjan bridges, DFS tree back-edges, 2-SAT implication graphs, Dinic bipartite matchings, and min-cost flow slope tricks.

schedule.title: Geometry & Linear Basis Invariants
schedule.summary: Drill Manhattan-to-Chebyshev rotations, angular sweep line, Pick Theorem, GF(2) linear basis, bit-trie D&C, and invariant reductions.
